title: Kafejnīcā (At the cafe)
summary: Two friends meet at a Riga cafe and order coffee and pastries together.

roles.name: Viesis A
roles.label: First guest
roles.objective: Greet your friend, suggest a table, and order a hot drink and something sweet.
starter_lines: Iesim pie tā galdiņa pie loga.

roles.name: Viesis B
roles.label: Second guest
roles.objective: Reply warmly, suggest something to share, and ask for the bill at the end.
starter_lines: Es vēlos zaļo tēju. Vai dalīsimies ar kūku?

objectives_shared: Greet each other politely in Latvian.
Order at least one drink each.
Ask for the bill before leaving.
safety_rules: Stay on the cafe topic — no personal contact info exchange.
